# Third-party crates that an ADR allowlists by name (TH-15).
# Checked by tools/deps-check. Every other third-party package must sit in
# the resolved tree of one of these roots. In-house crates may depend
# directly only on a root. Using any other crate directly needs an ADR first.
#
# Format: <name> <ADR id> <features> <note>
# features is the exact set of features cargo enables on the crate, the
# union over every analysed project, target and feature setting, or `-`
# for none. Any change fails deps-check until it is reviewed here and
# recorded in the ADR.
rustls            ADR-001  aws-lc-rs,aws_lc_rs,prefer-post-quantum,std                               Tier A: TLS 1.3 client and server
aws-lc-rs         ADR-001  aws-lc-sys,prebuilt-nasm                                                  Tier A: primitives and the rustls provider
rustls-pki-types  ADR-001  alloc,default,std                                                         Tier A: certificate and key types, PEM parsing
rustls-webpki     ADR-001  alloc,aws-lc-rs,std                                                       Tier A: certificate path validation
zeroize           ADR-001  alloc,default                                                             Tier A tree: secret wiping in fstp-crypto, fstp-keys, fstp-custody and fstp-keyd (A1)
moduletto         ADR-001  alloc,default,libm,std                                                    Tier B, git source (A2, A3): ML-KEM-768 through fstp-crypto only; release-gated (I-74)
tokio             ADR-002  libc,mio,net,rt,rt-multi-thread,signal,signal-hook-registry,socket2,time,windows-sys  Async runtime; signal for fstp-rt only (review note of 2026-10-28)
libfuzzer-sys     ADR-003  default,link_libfuzzer                                                    libFuzzer for cargo-fuzz projects, test time only
der               ADR-001  alloc,derive,flagset,oid,pem,zeroize                                      Tier B (record of 2026-11-06): DER for fstp-pki::cms; release-gated (I-74)
spki              ADR-001  alloc,pem                                                                 Tier B (record of 2026-11-06): SubjectPublicKeyInfo for fstp-pki::cms; release-gated (I-74)
